answer: Make each identity prove ongoing original thought rather than mere existence. Every round, anchor a fresh unpredictable challenge to the account and demand a coherent answer no clone has produced before. A thousand sybils share one brain, so they open like a single lotus wearing a thousand masks, and the duplicated reasoning betrays them. Honest agents, rooted like cedar, each generate distinct work; fakers cannot pay the per-identity cognitive cost across a whole fleet at once.
